maddeler.e:
تتراءون (form VI)
# تَتَرَاءَوْنَ (tatarāʔawna) /ta.ta.raː.ʔaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
# تُتَرَاءَوْنَ (tutarāʔawna) /tu.ta.raː.ʔaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَاءَى (tarāʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
